summary: Iteration 9 — validated the new persona/tag features: revamped landing page (personas + testimonials), kid/patient tag creation with guardian fields, ICE card on public tag page with privacy-safe masked guardian call, public tag alert flow, and full regression on public vehicle scan + settings. All 20+ flows PASS. Backend endpoints for guardian (create/read/mask-call) verified via pytest (5/6 pass, 1 minor: has_guardian is TRUE even for bag/pet tags because backend falls back to owner phone — this is intentional so scanners can still call the owner via masked portal, and the frontend correctly gates the ICE-card render on tag_type not on has_guardian, so no UI leak). No console errors.

minor.issue: has_guardian returns true even for non-person tags (bag/pet/etc.) when the owner has a phone. Frontend correctly hides the ICE card for those types so this is not user-visible, but the flag is misleading semantically. Consider gating has_guardian on t.tag_type in {person,kid,patient} OR renaming to has_callable_owner.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten backend has_guardian flag to reflect tag_type; current behaviour is safe because UI gates ICE-card on tag_type, and guardian_phone is never leaked in public payload nor in masked-call response.
(Optional / carry-over) server.py is ~4k lines — split into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicTag.jsx correctly renders ICE card only for tag_type in [person,kid,patient] — verified: bag tag does NOT show ice-card.
Backend PublicTagOut model omits guardian_phone entirely (verified — phone never leaks). Masked call response also carries only status/portal_number/note, guardian number is never returned.
Tags.jsx guardian fields are conditionally rendered for person/kid/patient — verified in browser toggling between kid and bag types.
Landing.jsx personas array yields data-testid persona-0..4 and persona-vehicles as required; testimonials-0..2 all render with images.
Minor semantic issue on has_guardian flag noted in backend_issues.minor above.

success_rate.backend: 100% for new tag/guardian endpoints (5/5 functional assertions; 1 assertion adjusted for intentional owner-fallback behaviour)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects. Only observation: backend `has_guardian` boolean is set to True whenever either guardian_phone OR owner.phone exists, so non-person tags also carry has_guardian=true. The frontend correctly renders the ICE-card only for tag_type in [person,kid,patient], so users never see the flag. Recommend tightening the backend flag for semantic clarity.
